records.title: OpenCodeReasoning-II: A Simple Test Time Scaling Approach via Self-Critique
records.reason: OpenCodeReasoning-II is a dataset and test-time scaling approach for code reasoning; the abstract reports dataset/quality scope, not reduced inference resources or serving cost.

records.title: Intrinsic Fingerprint of LLMs: Continue Training is NOT All You Need to Steal A Model!
records.reason: The paper fingerprints models for ownership/copyright protection; no inference-efficiency method is proposed.

records.title: PhysUniBench: An Undergraduate-Level Physics Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Models
records.reason: PhysUniBench is a multimodal physics reasoning benchmark; it evaluates capability and does not propose an inference-efficiency method.

records.title: How to Keep Pushing ML Accelerator Performance? Know Your Rooflines!
records.reason: The paper surveys machine-learning accelerator roofline trends across general ML workloads. It is not specifically an LLM inference/serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: A Review of DeepSeek Models' Key Innovative Techniques
records.reason: The survey’s demonstrated emphasis includes model development/training costs; direct coverage of inference/serving efficiency is not sufficiently specific for a concrete Research follow-up based on this screen.
